newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firms as Med drained by Far East.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firms as Med drained by Far East.

text.p: NWE spot naphtha was pushed higher on Monday with tight supply in the Mediterranean boosting the north European market.
Strong demand from the Far East has mopped up most available Algerian and Egyptian cargoes for March and traders say the market will now have to look to NWE for material.
"They supply 65 percent of the material in that market so where are buyers going to go now? NWE of course," said one trader.
April swaps were assessed as slightly higher at $190.50/$200.
No cargoes trade was reported but traders estimated a cargo would fetch around $195 a tonne.
